paraphrase: Two finite universally accessible, explanation-sound models separate the commitments: (1) a necessary actual individual has an explanation of every existence fact but no existent has a distinct external cause, and (2) a contingent actual individual has an explanation and a necessary actual individual exists, yet the existence of that necessary individual lacks any explanation. Thus an existence-PSR need not entail external causation, and a contingent-only existence-PSR need not entail an existence-PSR including necessary beings. Reasons and their adequacy are stipulated, not vindicated.
